First, note the given date: 08-31-1384 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
51 weeks and 1 day = 51 × 7 + 1 = 358 days.  

Subtract 358 days from 1384-08-31.  

1384 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
From 1384-08-31:  
Go back 31 days → 1384-07-31.  
Remaining 358 − 31 = 327 days.  

Go back to 1384-01-01 from 1384-07-31:  
Jan 31, Feb 29 (leap), Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31 → total 213 days in Jan–Jul.  
From 1384-07-31 back 213 days → 1384-01-01.  

Remaining 327 − 213 = 114 days to go back into 1383.  

1383 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1383-12-31 back:  
Dec 31, Nov 30, Oct 31 → 31+30+31 = 92 days, reaches 1383-10-01.  
Remaining 114 − 92 = 22 days back from 1383-10-01.  

September 1383 has 30 days.  
Back 22 days from Oct 1 → 1383-09-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1383-09-09
